name: 9 of Swords
description: The 9 of Swords is a tarot card associated with anxiety, fear, and mental anguish. It often represents sleepless nights, regret, and the pain of overthinking, reminding us to confront our worries and seek healing through honest self-reflection.

name: Gemini
description: Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury; it symbolizes communication, adaptability, and intellectual curiosity. Geminis are often social, quick-witted, and versatile, balancing dual perspectives while seeking connection through conversation and learning.

name: Indigo Chakra
description: The indigo chakra, also known as the third eye chakra, is linked to intuition, insight, and inner wisdom. It encourages clarity of perception, heightened awareness, and the ability to see beyond surface reality to access deeper spiritual truths.
